howScores.title: How scores work
howScores.intro: Every player's vote weighs the same. Critics, streamers and first-time players all get exactly one rating per game. A review earns visibility only when other players mark it as helpful.
howScores.rule1Body: A rating counts toward a game's community score when its author has a verified email and an account at least 3 days old. Every rating still shows on its author's profile.
howScores.rule2Body: We sort the counted ratings, drop the highest 10% and the lowest 10%, and average the rest. A wave of 1s or 100s from people trying to push a game up or down barely moves it.
howScores.rule3Body: A game needs at least 5 counted ratings before it shows a community score or appears in rankings.
